# Week 10: Writing & Publishing Reports {.unnumbered}

## Overview

This week turns a slide-sized finding into a short reproducible report. A report does more than present a result. It shows where the data came from, how the output was generated, what the evidence supports, and what remains uncertain.

The default publishing pathway is a private preview unless the data, repository, and group privacy checks show that public sharing is safe.

## Objectives

By the end of the week you can:

- structure a short Quarto report around one descriptive question;
- generate one table and one figure from code;
- cite a data source using a BibTeX workflow;
- trace key claims to code output, citations, or limitations;
- choose a private or public preview route based on privacy and stewardship checks.

## Connection

Week 9 turned one finding into a concise slide story. Week 10 expands the same evidence into a reproducible report and M3 project update. Week 11 then stress-tests whether the report and KT product run in a fresh environment.

## Class Plan

1. Start from one Week 9 claim or one M3-ready finding.
2. Draft a report outline: question, data, methods, results, limitations.
3. Render the [Report Template](report-template.qmd) and identify the table, figure, citation, and limitation.
4. Add or revise one citation/source note.
5. Complete a grounding audit for three claims.
6. Decide whether the preview should stay private or can be public-safe.

## Student Output

By the end of class each group has a report outline, a rendered template or draft report, a citation/source note, three grounded claims, and an M3 feedback request.

## Definition of Done

- The report source renders.
- One table and one figure are generated by code.
- Citations resolve.
- The limitation section avoids unsupported causal or population-level claims.
- The preview route protects data and group privacy.

## What Students Leave With

A short report draft and project update that can be reviewed in Week 11 for reproducibility, clarity, auditability, and KT value.
